news.h: Will Josh Downs be traded at the deadline?
news.d: Stephen Holder breaks down Josh Downs' trade status after two dropped passes before the upcoming deadline.

news.h: Multidrop game in Colts' loss irks WR Josh Downs as trade deadline looms
news.d: Veteran receiver Josh Downs, who recently requested a trade away from the Indianapolis Colts, authored one of the most forgettable performances of his career Sunday, a multidrop effort at Lucas Oil Stadium in his team's 27-23 loss to the Dallas Cowboys.
